protocol.title: Attractive Design: An Elution Solvent Optimization Platform for Magnetic-Bead-based Fractionation Using Digital Microfluidics and Design of Experiments
protocol.platform: Digital microfluidics (DMF) with C18-functionalized magnetic beads
protocol.objective: C18 magnetic bead-based solid phase extraction on DMF with automated on-chip elution solvent optimization via design of experiments (DOE), multianalyte fractionation, and dried blood spot sample cleanup

bottom_plate.substrate: Glass slide precoated with chromium (200 nm) and photoresist (AZ1500, 530 nm)
bottom_plate.electrode_array: 15 x 4 driving electrodes (2 x 2 mm each)
bottom_plate.hydrophobic_coating: Teflon AF, 50 nm, spin-coated (1000 rpm, 30 s), post-baked 160 C, 10 min
bottom_plate.fabrication: Photolithography and wet etching, Toronto Nanofabrication Centre, University of Toronto

top_plate.substrate: ITO-coated glass (Delta Technologies Ltd., Stillwater, MN)

assembly.spacer: Three layers of double-sided tape (3M), total 270 um

actuation.control: Automated control system with integrated moveable magnetic lens

magnetic_lens.type: Motorised vertical step-motor, moveable beneath DMF device
magnetic_lens.function: Reversible immobilisation of C18 magnetic beads on device surface
magnetic_lens.engaged: Lens positioned close to device; beads pinned to surface
magnetic_lens.disengaged: Lens moved away; beads suspended in droplet for mixing

fluorescein.role: Model analyte for loading capacity characterisation

sitamaquine.role: Small-molecule antimalarial drug; model pharmaceutical analyte
sitamaquine.supplier: Graciously provided by GlaxoSmithKline (GSK), Stevenage, UK

internal_standard_sitamaquine.supplier: Graciously provided by GSK, Stevenage, UK

dbs.blood: Human whole blood, BioChemed Services, Winchester, VA
dbs.card: PerkinElmer 226 Sample Collection Cards, Greenville, SC

reagents.antifouling_note: Pluronic F-127 (common DMF additive) found INCOMPATIBLE with this protocol. Pluronic caused micellar encapsulation of hydrophobic analytes and/or coating of C18 bead surfaces, significantly reducing extraction performance. Pluronics NOT used in this protocol.

fundamental_operations.i_engulf: Droplet dispensed, driven to bead bed; beads engulfed by droplet
fundamental_operations.ii_mix: Magnetic lens disengaged; beads suspended and mixed via DMF actuation
fundamental_operations.iii_remove: Magnetic lens engaged; beads immobilised; supernatant driven away

steps.name: Dispense bead bed
steps.notes: ~9e7 beads per bed; bed size tunable on-the-fly (6 uL -> ~5.4e7 beads; 12 uL -> ~1.08e8 beads)

steps.name: Activate C18 stationary phase
steps.notes: Activates collapsed C18 chains into extended conformation for reversed-phase interaction

steps.name: Wash beads
steps.notes: Equilibrates beads to aqueous phase prior to sample loading

steps.name: Load sample and incubate
steps.mixing: DMF actuation (continuous droplet mixing for 5 min)
steps.notes: Analyte adsorbs onto C18 stationary phase during incubation

steps.name: Elute
steps.reagent: Optimised elution solvent (composed on-chip from unit droplets)
steps.notes: Solvent composition determined by DOE; generated on-chip from neat reservoir solvents

loading_capacity.detection: Fluorescence plate reader (PheraStar, BMG Labtech, Durham, NC); ex 480 nm, em 520 nm

equilibrium_sitamaquine.stationary_phase_assumption: Shell with uniform thickness = octadecyl alkane chain length (2.14 nm)
equilibrium_sitamaquine.notes: Fits within commonly reported range for SPE solute-sorbent equilibria

sitamaquine.trend: Increasing efficiency with increasing organic fraction; MeOH > ACN > H2O

angiotensin_I.trend: Aqueous/acetonitrile mixture optimal; consistent with reversed-phase peptide HPLC practice

on_chip_mixing.method: Unit droplets (2.5 uL) dispensed from reservoir electrodes and merged on-chip
on_chip_mixing.notes: Arbitrary mixtures generated by combining appropriate number of unit droplets; library of 7 compositions created automatically

extraction_efficiency_comparison.result: Comparable extraction efficiencies for both analytes (Fig. 5)

dbs_extraction.purpose: Proof-of-principle for real-world sample cleanup; reduce ionisation suppression from blood matrix

on_chip_dilution.notes: Dilution required to achieve aqueous matrix compatible with C18 reversed-phase SPE

dbs_extraction.cleanup: C18 bead SPE as described; elution in neat methanol (10 uL)

detection.instrument: API 4000 Triple Quadrupole MS/MS (AB Sciex, Concord, Ontario)

dbs_extraction.result: Sitamaquine signal at 271 m/z strongly enhanced post-cleanup vs. raw DBS extract; reduced ionisation suppression by matrix components (Fig. 7)

sitamaquine.mode: ESI-MS/MS, positive ion, selected reaction monitoring (SRM)

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.content: Bead dispensing, C18 activation, wash, sample loading (fluorescein QC)

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_5_t
basic_blocks.action: dispose all DOE eluates and signals
